_provenance: S7a Task R5 -- tests/test_render_csg.cpp's CsgMeshGolden.MatchesCommittedManifest. sha256 of each subtree's surface-nets positions bytes followed by its indices bytes, both taken from mesh_csg_subtree() at kCsgMeshDefaults over the bounds csg_subtree_world_bounds() derives for the fixture in that test file's golden_fixtures(). Unlike tessellate.hpp's tessellation manifest, vertex/index counts have no independent closed form to re-derive them from (they depend on the subtree's actual zero-crossing topology, not on cells_per_axis alone) -- these are snapshot-pinned, the same posture test_render_raster.cpp's frame goldens already use. limits_version is bumped ONLY alongside a deliberate kCsgMeshDefaults change, together with the matching constant in the test file.
_changelog: Fix wave 1 (review IMPORTANT #1 + #2): csg_subtree_world_bounds() was rewritten from a flat union of every leaf's own extent to a CSG-aware recursive walk (union/intersect/subtract/smooth_union each narrow or discard an operand's extent per its own semantics, not a blanket union), and mesh_csg_subtree()'s own padding margin now floors at k/4 when root_node is itself a smooth_union (sdf.cpp's own bound on the blend). Both hashes moved as a direct, understood consequence, not a regression: gate_square's bound is now the SUBTRACT's minuend alone (the outer box, half-extent 0.3 in Z) rather than the union of both operands (which wrongly included the 0.5-deep subtrahend) -- Z now gets the full 48-cell resolution instead of ~26 of 48, so vertex/index counts INCREASED (10944->15200, 65664->91200). smooth_blend_cylinder_sphere's bound now carries the correct k/4 dilation at the bounds-computation level PLUS mesh_csg_subtree()'s own independent k/4 margin floor (defence in depth: the second one protects mesh_csg_subtree()'s own contract even if a future caller does not route through csg_subtree_world_bounds()) -- the resulting sampling volume is slightly larger overall than before, so at the same fixed 48 cells/axis the resolution over the actual shape is slightly coarser and counts DECREASED (10552->9056, 63300->54324). limits_version stays kCsgMeshDefaults@1 because the limits table itself did not change -- only what the code does with subtree_bounds/aabb_margin did.
